use_case_name: Decorrelate Diverging Air or Surface Tracks

claims.content: The use case decorrelates any two air tracks or any two surface tracks that meet the decorrelation criteria, thereby minimizing the occurrences and duration of dual designations.

goal.raw_text: The use case decorrelates any two air tracks or any two surface tracks that meet the decorrelation criteria, thereby minimizing the occurrences and duration of dual designations.

claims.content: C2 JU
The two tracks to be decorrelated are either any two air tracks or any two surface tracks.
The C2 JU has an automatic decorrelation capability for real-time air or surface tracks it initiates, or it is performing manual decorrelation, which C2 JUs may also do.
The tracks meet the applicable decorrelation criteria.
When the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's decorrelation criteria, the C2 JU shall decorrelate the PPLI and local track data.

trigger.raw_text: When the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's decorrelation criteria, the C2 JU shall decorrelate the PPLI and local track data.

claims.content: The C2 JU performs automatic decorrelation tests for each common local track upon receipt of each J2 or J3 message on the track.

The C2 JU determines that the common local track (TN A) satisfies the criteria of an automatic or manual decorrelation when, on receipt of 2(1-5, 1) consecutive remote track reports, the remote track falls outside a distance of 1.5(1.0-2.0, 0.1) times the maximum correlation distance calculated in accordance with paragraph 4.4.4.3.1f(3).
After it has been determined that the common local track (TN A) satisfies the criteria of an automatic or manual decorrelation, the C2 JU executes the decorrelation.
If TN A has been correlated with an Index Number by own unit, the C2 JU assesses whether the Index Number should remain with TN A or B, and transmits J12.5 messages as appropriate.
After decorrelation, the C2 JU initiates a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number.
C2 JUs may also perform manual decorrelation in addition to automatic decorrelation.
If the C2 JU has a capability to require manual confirmation of automatic decorrelations, manual confirmation of automatic decorrelations is required.

If TN A is the subject of a handover which is in progress, i.e., a TN in a J10.3 Handover message, the decorrelation shall be delayed until the handover process is completed or terminated; then the decorrelation shall be executed and an operator alerted as a cue to report control in the J10.5 Controlling Unit Report message as appropriate; operator display of the pending decorrelation shall be provided.

1. If TN A is controlled by own unit; i.e., is the subject of own unit reported J10.5 Controlling Unit Report message, do not automatically decorrelate; exit the automatic decorrelation path. If manually decorrelated, alert the operator as a cue to report termination of control TN A if appropriate. Report commencement of control of TN B using the J10.5 message only if initiated by operator action.
The PPLI and local track data are decorrelated.
After decorrelation, the C2 JU has initiated a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number.
If TN A had been correlated with an Index Number by own unit, whether the Index Number should remain with TN A or B has been assessed, and J12.5 messages have been transmitted as appropriate.

If TN A was the subject of a pending J9.0 Command message which own unit originated or to which own unit was preparing a reply, operator display of new track status on TNs A and B has been provided before release of the J9.0 reply, and the reply is relative to TN A.

If TN A was the subject of a handover in progress, the handover process has been completed or terminated, the decorrelation has been executed, and the operator has been alerted as a cue to report control in the J10.5 Controlling Unit Report message as appropriate; operator display of the pending decorrelation has been provided.

If TN A was controlled by own unit and was manually decorrelated, the operator has been alerted as a cue to report termination of control TN A if appropriate, and commencement of control of TN B using the J10.5 message has been reported only if initiated by operator action.
